https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343710

The demo showcases a range of exciting game mechanics, challenging tasks, and a glimpse of the extensive collection of fishing equipment you'll get to utilize in the entire game. notes.title: Professional Fishing | New interface, new catch camera and more!
notes.notes:
So, here we are! It took us a while but we finally did it. Today we bring a totally new interface for our game and a few other things. 

Hope you will like the changes that we made. Please, welcome the 1.1 update! 


[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[i]Version:[/i] 1.1
[b]Added / New:[/b][list]
[*][b]New interface[/b][list]
[*]fish species are visible on the map selection screen,
[*]the selection of lures and equipment takes place by pressing the icon. You no longer have to drag & drop items.
[*]the name of the map and room number is displayed in the game interface,
[*]player profile is now also available from the fishery,
[*]new music in-game menu,[/list]
[*][b]New catch camera[/b] - 3rd person view for fish weighing over 5 kg,
[*]Fish weighing over 5 kg can be sold without leaving the map,
[*]Tips of some floats now glow at night,[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b][list]
[*][b]VIP account[/b][list]
[*][b]level requirements[/b]:
From today's update, the VIP account will no longer unlock all maps and items. The new VIP system lowers the required level for equipment and maps by 6 levels. 
The rest of the VIP account functionality remained unchanged.[/list]

[*] [b]Items durability[/b]
Lures, lines, and other consumable items wear out only if you caught or lost the fish. 

[*]Russian map:[list]
[*]new lake in the middle of the forest,
[*]terrain modification near the start location, [/list]

[*] Increased number of fish on some maps,
[/list]

[h1]New interface[/h1]
What can I say - just turn on the game and tell us what you think about it! The team did a really great job. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33265723/d26619e5313653cce9722d018b9232207c3923c4.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33265723/7027e1657e63595cfc0459438442ff1fba72b304.jpg[/img]

[h1]VIP changes[/h1]
Since today's update, the VIP account has been slightly changed. Many people complained that playing the game with VIP was becoming pointless for them - because everything in the store, as well as all maps, are already unlocked. So we decided to make a small change - from today the VIP account reduces the required level by 6 levels.

How does it look in practice?
Normal account: Sakura Mitsio (required level 24)
VIP account: Sakura Mitsio (required level 18)

This is quite a significant change, so we will want to conduct a survey and get to know your opinion on the changes introduced in update 1.1.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33265723/7027e1657e63595cfc0459438442ff1fba72b304.jpg[/img]

[h1]Consumable items wear[/h1]
Many players complained about the rapid wear of consumables. Therefore, we decided to change it and from now, all consumables items will wear out only after a successful catch or fish lose (line broke, etc.). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33265723/90c316cb8f87caf505868be7a8ddd46ff3c58688.jpg[/img]

[h1]Night floats[/h1]
A small change, but important as any other! Some floats glow now at night! Night fishing should be much easier now! 

[h1]New catch camera[/h1]
So it's finally here! Thanks to everyone for participating in the open beta tests! Thanks to you, we have improved a few things and we hope that big fish will look really big now!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33265723/9ae38bba21938bd1bfe53adbd4fe388d7e781b58.jpg[/img]

[i]Kind Regards,
Rafał - Project Manager in Ultimate Games S.A.[/i]

notes.title: What's Next? #2 | New UI, trophy view and fish scale
notes.notes:
Good morning everyone,
I hope you have a bad mood because I've some good news for you :) 

Our small team works in the sweat of their foreheads to introduce profound patches and new features to Professional Fishing. What? I will talk about some of them below :)

[i]Remember! Everything that what you will see here is work-in-progress footage.[/i]


[h1][b]New user interface (UI)[/b][/h1]
Since the game launch, many people have complained about the quality and readability of the GUI in the game. We have never denied that it is good, on the contrary - we said you were right. Our small team has found some time and is working on a completely new UI.

What are its assumptions?

[b]Simple - Readable - Functional[/b]

I wonder what it will look like? Here's a small preview :)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33173199/0ad88b935f3060daa4c45782659dca95efdc2031.jpg[/img]

Tell us how do you like it! 

[h1][b]Fish scale[/b][/h1]
We have already mentioned this recently and would like to inform you that the changes are going very smoothly. We try to adjust the size of the fish in relation to the player's form based on real pictures of fish and fishermen in reality.

With the new scaling of fish, many of them will be 'huge' which will require a new view of the trophy (from a different perspective). More about it below :)

Many people - including us, wanted to introduce large (really huge!) fish that will delight players with their size. Due to having only one trophy view (fish) - from the first person perspective, it was hard for players to enjoy the view of huge honkers!

We finally decided to implement this idea and we started working on the view of the trophy from a different perspective. Below you will find a screenshot.

In recent days, several people have been banned in the game with displayed ban reason as: "catching fish". 

It was caused by wrong server-side anti-cheat configuration at our new map -  Bass Marshland.

We were trying to unban everyone as fast as we can. If you are still banned without a reason, please create a ticket here: https://professionalfishing.freshdesk.com

Of course, everyone is compensated in the form of VIP days and cash in the game.

[h1]Critical gameplay error caused by 1.0.18 patch[/h1]
After a few days of searching for errors and the reasons for their creation, we finally succeeded - we found the source of problems and eliminated them. We would like to apologize to everyone for this event. If with the update 1.0.18, your game ceased to be unplayable, I would very much ask you to create a support ticket. We'll compensate for your lost time.

[h1]Scale size of fish[/h1]
Soon, we should release also a new patch, which will introduce major changes to the fish scaling system. Thanks to this, large fish will finally look big. This system involves many other things, such as a new system of pulling fish out of the water and fish presentation (you wouldn't be able to hold 60kg catfish in real-life). Unfortunately, we can't do this at the same time and we have to do things one by one.

Here is a sneak peek of 55kg wels catfish:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33173199/4e863de5c5e71a02c43b2b4e9cf11f6a6201c967.png[/img]

Therefore - first we will release a patch with a new fish scaling system and later the other ones. 

[h1]Reels durability[/h1]
Many times you mentioned on the forum that the reels are too weak, so we decided to make some change introducing more realism. The durability of the reel will be several times greater.

Why? Until now, the value of the drag in the reels corresponded to the weight of the fish he could pull out. However, as we know, in reality, it looks a bit different, because the "water buoyancy" works on fish, which makes them seem lighter when we pull them. We've introduced a similar rule to the game, so reels are now 'stronger'. We hope you will be satisfied with it.

Today is the first step in new durability system. From now the rods have the maximum weight they can carry. If the player will try to pull a fish bigger than the endurance of the rod - it will be gradually worn out. 

*We also fixed the bug that caused all rods to have the same durability. Therefore, players had a lot of problems with pulling fish on more expensive fishing rods - because they had the same max. weight as cheapest one.

[h1]Changed prices[/h1]
As many of you have noticed, we have changed the prices of some items such as fishing rods. They are more expensive now.

Why did we do this? With the introduction of new parameters, we had to balance the sense of the existence of different rods and make space for new items.

The range has become so big because the catfish is one of the strongest rods in the game. Between her and the cheapest, there will be a lot of new models.

[h1]Cheaters[/h1]
In recent days, you have been witnesses of various cheaters in the game. We have already detected errors (with the help of a certain person) and will try to fix them as soon as possible.

How many languages will be in game?[/h1]

In the Beta version there will be two languages available - English and Polish. On the release day, the game will support over 10 languages.

What is the leveling system [/h1]

The player receives exp and $ for each caught fish. The more experience a player gains, the higher player level will be. Levels are necessary to unlock equipment and other things.

So in FB vidéo we can see 2 fishing technic, float and spining, is there bottom fishing? [/h1]

How many species when the game will be released, in the trailer we can see 8 species, 4 for spining, 4 for float.  [/h1]

So, for what I understand, the map is only one big open world. Am I right?[/h1]

Ok, we'll see the closed beta in 2 weeks or something like that, but some inputs on how the f2p mechanics work? Will there be some sort of premium pass? [*] lower prices, 
[*] extra exp, 
[*] extra $ when selling fish,
[*] free transport usage,
[*] VIP fishery on map,
or
[*] buying items without having required lvl,[/list]

Whats the biggest fish / monster fish in the game ?  [/h1]

Yes, we have some huge fish. One of them is a catfish whose weight exceeds 100 kg, but we have to work new method and animations to pull so huge fish from water. Due to this, for this moment biggest fish that can be pulled out from water have 30kg.

[quote=Limey21][h1]
Will we be able to see other players as whole body avatars? [/h1]

We have full 3D body models and animations. Everything is rigged.

It depends from many aspects like weather, time of day, bait type, depth. That mean you can catch really often crucian carps but you will have to find catfish.

Yes, you can. We don’t have NDA during beta tests. 


[h1] I hope you know more now :) [/h1]

If you have more questions please, write them in comments under this post.
